text:
alice: PM asked for a short migration handoff for v1->v2 deprecation. Deliverables: one-line site banner, a one-page migration doc, three language snippet pairs (py/ts/go), a small compat shim example, redirect plan + automation, and a PR template with a smoke checklist. Target publish: 2025-05-30 AM. Who can own which piece?
ben: Ill take the PR template + labels + GH action for link-checker. Will add labels: docs-deprecate, needs-smoke, redirect-needed.
clara: Ill draft the model-mapping doc. Will include a compact table and a clear callout for embeddings: "old-embed-512 -> redwood-embed-1024" with reindex guidance and alias fallback advice.
diego: Ill own snippets. Side-by-side examples and a tiny shim marked "temporary". Quick py example: ```
# v1 (old)
resp = client.models.invoke("gpt-redwood-01", input="hi")
# v2 (new)
resp = client.responses.create(model="gpt-redwood-01", input=[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}])
```
Temp shim: ```python
def invoke_v1_shim(client, model, text):
    return client.responses.create(model=model, input=[{"role":"user","content": text}])
```
Also update streaming snippet: old SSE `event: chunk` -> new `event: response.delta`, final event `done` -> `response.complete`. Ill run the streaming smoke harness on staging.
infra-bot: Automation note: once mapping is merged we can auto-generate redirects for /v1/* to mapped /v2/* pages. Recommend CI fail if any /v1/* page remains unmapped and label the PR needs-redirect.
alice: Banner copy suggestion (1-line): "Deprecation Notice: v1 API will be retired on 2025-06-01. See migration guide." Keep it short and linkable. Also add a short release-notes blurb about SDK rename (client.models.invoke -> client.responses.create) and model swap mapping.
ben: I'll open the template PR and add the workflow today. PR will require authors to paste smoke test artifacts and list redirects.
clara: Draft mapping PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2731 (WIP model map and embed-dim notes).
diego: Snippet PR incoming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2732  includes py/ts/go pairs, shim, and streaming example plus smoke logs.
alice: Great. Once those land Ill assemble /docs/deprecation/playbook.md that wires the pieces and triggers the redirect generator. Set a reminder for 2025-05-28 09:00 UTC to verify redirects and banner staging. If smoke tests fail, tag #eng-oncall. Thanks everyone!
